evals.title: Collective credit and calibrated causality
evidence: apps/www/src/data/knowledge-bank/teams-archive.ts: CLM-CRS-COALITION-OPERATING-SYSTEM names Jamie's design and maintenance actions while distinguishing the planned six-part structure from completed implementation and collaborative minutes from sole authorship.

apps/www/src/data/knowledge-bank/nycac-research-2026-07-14.ts: CLM-NYCAC-CABARET-REPEAL-CONTRIBUTION-CANDIDATE names Jamie's fire-code study groups and City Hall rally while preserving credit for the multi-group campaign, Council Member Rafael Espinal, other advocates, the Council, and the Mayor.

apps/www/src/data/knowledge-bank/nycac-research-2026-07-14.ts: CLM-NYCAC-OFFICE-CREATION-CONTRIBUTION-CANDIDATE remains held with empty surfaces; CLM-NYCAC-MARCH-TRANSPARENCY-LAW and CLM-NYCAC-MARCH-REPLACED-BY-CURE keep legislative enactment and institutional replacement separate from Jamie's actions.

apps/www/src/data/knowledge-bank/kc-town-hall-funding.ts: CLM-KCTH-MISSION-ALIGNED-TRANSITION explicitly attributes transition context to Jamie, separates it from official City records, and withholds receiving organization, transfer mechanics, causality, and private reasons.

apps/www/src/data/knowledge-bank/teams-archive.ts: CLM-NYCAC-ARCHIVAL-PUBLICATION-WORKFLOW distinctly credits Jamie's source assembly, Dorothy Howard's review and mainspace move, and later editors' maintenance; CLM-WATERWAYS-RAFT-EXPEDITION-SCALE preserves collective construction and the unrecovered endpoint.
Fresh validation passed: 15/15 knowledge-development tests, citation consistency, public-safety, knowledge-bank, and route checks; the deterministic run reported zero projection-safety violations.
findings: Jamie's documented actions are consistently stated with strong verbs—designed, maintained, translated, organized, rallied, testified, assembled, and transitioned—rather than hidden behind generic participation language.
Collaborator, coalition, legislative, agency, and later-editor contributions remain distinct from Jamie's direct work.
Created, caused, adopted, implemented, completed, and disbanded formulations are either rejected, explicitly bounded, or held pending stronger evidence.
evals.recommended_next_move: Preserve these claim-level distinctions during future promotion, especially the held Office of Nightlife creation claim, the raft endpoint, and the attributed KC Town Hall transition.

evals.title: Source-backed strength through Chad's lens
evidence: apps/www/src/content/work/fair-rent-nyc.mdx makes Jamie's actions explicit: designing the operating plan, maintaining shared memory, creating the provenance redline, translating policy and data questions, building campaign sites, organizing study groups, rallying, and testifying.

apps/www/src/content/work/fair-rent-nyc.mdx identifies intended users and uses: collaborators could orient after meetings, inspect sources, track next steps, identify open questions, and prepare public-safe explanations.

apps/www/src/data/work.ts makes the usable artifact set concrete: campaign-memory spine, six-part operating plan, legislative provenance redline, policy-question log, privacy-preserving pilot specification, public websites, and testimony/policy trail.

CLM-CRS-OPEN-DATA-IMPLEMENTATION-DESIGN in apps/www/src/data/knowledge-bank/teams-archive.ts specifies indicators, suppression reporting, methods, and release fields while explicitly denying City adoption, implementation, confidential-data access, or policy outcome.

docs/knowledge-bank/promotion-slate.md keeps CLM-SOURCE-BACKED-MEMORY-DISCOVERY-PROCESS, CLM-NYCAC-OFFICE-CREATION-CONTRIBUTION-CANDIDATE, and CLM-NYCAC-FIREGUARD-PASS-RATE-ATTESTED visible as prioritized research rather than weak public prose.

RT-TEAMS-JOBHUNT-JUNE-PACKET-HYDRATION and INQ-TEAMS-JOBHUNT-ICLOUD-HYDRATION-2026 in apps/www/src/data/knowledge-bank/teams-archive.ts record non-materialization as retryable retrieval state, explicitly not absence or inferred evidence.

apps/www/src/content/work/kc-town-hall.mdx candidly preserves withdrawal and reappropriation while separately framing Jamie's mission-aligned transition as stewardship supported only by his approved first-hand account.
findings: A skeptical hiring reader can identify the action, audience, operational artifacts, public purpose, and privacy/adoption boundaries without reconstructing them from source metadata.
The selected Fair Rent material is forceful without inflating implementation or policy causality.
High-value unresolved claims remain legible in the research queue and do not leak into the public site.
evals.recommended_next_move: Keep the current Fair Rent composition; pursue the named Office-creation, Fireguard-metric, and June-packet research tasks before considering stronger outcome language.
